x: Jack Rutland is mentioned in despatches and also G. Warr who is improving quickly, but the hero of the day was Bob Readman who although feeling the effects of the National Police Championship two days previously battled to the finish to score for us.
G. Warr won the London Universities 1 mile track walk in record time.
The handicap was won by G.

As a well-known walker reported : “We were unfancied for a scoring place,” but whatever the day or course, the lads walked extremely well. From roughly fifth place at half-way, they fought through to finish a comfortable second, the scoring lads being G.
